NEGATIVE_EQUITY: Negative equity of {{amount}} is rolled into the new loan.
OVER_TARGET: All-in monthly is {{over}} over your target.
OVER_MAX_BUDGET: Purchase price is {{over}} above the solved max budget ({{max}}).
OPERATING_EXCEEDS_TARGET: Insurance + maintenance + fuel alone exceed your target all-in monthly — no loan room left.
LONG_TERM: Term of {{months}} months is longer than the typical 84-month ceiling.
BC_PST_TIER_NEAR: Purchase price is near a BC PST rate tier boundary — small price changes can jump the rate.
LUXURY_TAX: Federal luxury tax of {{amount}} applies (new vehicles over $100,000).
EVAP_ALREADY_CLAIMED: You marked federal EVAP as already claimed — rebate set to $0.
MANUAL_OVERRIDE_ACTIVE: One or more fields use manual overrides; downstream totals may be derived from those values.
